name: Feishu File Outbox Router
description: Stage message tool media from Feishu workspaces and researcher Feishu exports into per-user/per-group outbox under ~/.openclaw/workspace before sending.

outboxRoot.description: Root directory for staged outbox files (default: ~/.openclaw/workspace).

sourcePrefix.description: Single source prefix to stage from (legacy).

sourcePrefixes.description: Source path prefixes eligible for staging.

targetPrefixes.description: Source path prefixes that require explicit Feishu target/to/channelId instead of agentId fallback.

explicitTargetRequiredPrefixes.description: Source path prefixes that require explicit Feishu target/to/channelId instead of agentId fallback.

exportPrefix.description: Relative export prefix used to detect researcher export files (default: artifacts/exports/feishu).

openclawRoot.description: OpenClaw state root used to resolve configured agent workspaces when deriving default source prefixes.

researcherAgentId.description: Researcher agent id used to resolve the default researcher workspace (default: researcher).

researcherWorkspaceRoot.description: Explicit researcher workspace root used to resolve researcher export files.
